hook_text: Desert, forest, grassland, ocean: one country, so many different homes. Which would you live in?
clip_script: Upington: red sand, hot sun. Meerkats pop out of their burrows. Drive east: endless grass, blesbok grazing. Up into the Drakensberg: cold peaks, vultures on the cliffs. Down to Knysna: a dark, damp forest and a bright green turaco. Then the sea: penguins and seals on the rocks. Same planet, totally different homes. These are habitats, and every plant and animal is suited to its own.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of South Africa with little picture stickers: a meerkat in the Kalahari, a turaco in the Knysna forest, a blesbok on the Highveld grassland, a hippo in a wetland and a penguin on the coast.
mood: Curious and adventurous, like a family road trip with the windows down.
pacing: One stop per habitat, a quick look at what makes it different, then the animals and plants that suit it.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and name the habitat closest to your home.
